summary: Tested the diagnostic stage, the spoken end-of-lesson summary, the parent-panel summaries section, the real Riyaziyyat lesson count, and the retry regression. Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests pass (test_diagnostic_summary.py). Frontend (Playwright, isolated TEST students): every requested flow works. The Riyaziyyat card shows '39 mövzu' and the other subjects show their topic count. A lesson opens with a greeting and a diagnostic question, stage-chip-diagnostic is active, and step-recall-btn is absent, including while the answer streams. After the answer the stage becomes '2. İzah' and step-recall-btn appears. The full flow recall -> step-quiz-btn -> lesson-complete-btn adds a 2-3 sentence summary bubble (listen-btn-summary*) and sends exactly 1 /api/tts request with the summary text. The stage becomes done and mini-quiz-btn is shown. The parent panel (new PIN 1234 on the TEST student) lists 1 summary-item-<id> with topic, subject and date; summaries-empty does not show. Re-entering a lesson with only 1 assistant message resumes in diagnostic. Retry check: /api/chat was aborted during the diagnostic answer, so error-block appeared with no recall button; after unrouting and clicking retry-btn there were 0 error blocks, a single user bubble, 3 bubbles in total, and the stage moved to explained.

minor.issue: Any client can call it without completing a lesson, and there is no rate limit, so repeated calls each trigger an LLM call and add a duplicate summary to Mongo.

integration_issues.issue: The summary bubble exists only in frontend state. It is not saved to db.messages, so it disappears from the chat after a reload or re-entry. It is still saved in lesson_summaries for parents.

issues: The date uses toLocaleDateString('az-AZ'), which renders as ISO-like '2026-10-20'. Acceptable, but 'dd.mm.yyyy' may read better for parents.

action_items: Optional: persist the summary as an assistant message, or reload the latest summary on re-entry, so the child can listen to it again
Optional: tie POST /api/lesson-summary to a lesson completion, or limit it to one per lesson per day
critical_code_review_comments: TutorChat.jsx is 584 lines and getting close to the 700-line limit. Consider moving the lesson-stage logic (runAssistant, stage controls, summary) into a hook.

App.js does not restore the lesson view after F5; the app reloads to Home. The resume entry TutorChat writes to localStorage is not removed by a reload, so a later re-entry can pick up that old stage. Only matters if F5 lesson restore is expected.

The summary prompt is built only from the conversation, so the summary can mention content from the child's own recall that is unrelated to the topic (seen in testing: a 'kəsrlər' remark on the '1.1 İlkin yoxlama' topic). This is expected behaviour, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST students 'TEST_ui_iter7' (id 4dad6173ce504dbbaf8c3a855e023e4b, parent PIN 1234, 1 summary) and 'TEST_ui_iter7b', plus one pytest TEST_diag_* student. Textbook and lesson data were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stages run diagnostic -> explained -> recall_input/recalled -> quiz -> done. To use an isolated student, POST /api/students and set localStorage 'agilli-ders-student-id'. The Riyaziyyat card is subject-card-riyaziyyat. The summary bubble testid prefix is listen-btn-summary. Parent panel: parent-panel-btn -> pin-input/pin-confirm-input/pin-submit-btn (create mode for a new student) -> parent-summaries. F5 does not restore the lesson view (App returns to Home).
